answer: Each AI agent must lock a minimum stake of the native token; the required stake scales with total network value, so a Sybil attacker must acquire a proportional share of the economy. The stake is recorded in a quartz ledger and verified inside a hardware enclave, preventing any agent from trying to forge a false identity. At the zenith of this design, slashing instantly reclaims misbehaving stakes, making large-scale identity creation economically prohibitive.
